## Content and publication checks

- [ ] Visitor-facing text states only confirmed facts. No placeholder hours, emails, domains, or claims.
- [ ] French and English pages match in facts, links, and structured data.
- [ ] Only files under `public/` are published. No private files were added.
- [ ] Changed files contain no em dashes, HTML comments, invisible Unicode, or URL tracking parameters.
- [ ] Structured data (`application/ld+json`) parses as valid JSON.

## Visitor checks

Skip this section if no page or style changed.

- [ ] The new-patient notice, address, and phone number are easy to find on phone and desktop.
- [ ] Phone links use `tel:+14506995623`.
- [ ] Every action works without JavaScript. No trackers, cookies, forms, embedded maps, or third-party requests on page load.
- [ ] Text contrast is at least 4.5:1. Focus is visible. Touch targets are at least 44 px.
- [ ] Layout has no horizontal scroll at 320 px or at 200% zoom.
- [ ] Reduced-motion preferences are respected.
- [ ] Any added font, image, or code has a licence that allows use on this site.
